name: First Day
author: Addicting Games
description: First Day is a free desktop bullet-hell game. It's your first day at a new job and nothing makes any sense. Welcome to life in an absurd future of cubicles, computers, and bosses. Never-ending bosses.  Your boss has an awful task for him, you need to take notes in the most unusual manner possible. Keep your eyes on the left-hand side of the screen for the words and letters you're supposed to spell. When the game starts whole alphabets full of letters will begin to rain down from the sky, your job (literally your job) is to fire at the letters and make sure to only hit letters from the specific words and nothing else. Missing the appropriate letter will end in your termination, and you do not want to be looking for a job in this market. This is a game that teaches you the rigors of the real world and the terrible practices and policies of office politics. The first day is a classic game in the mold of our older Flash games. We think you'll really like this one.
